title: Raising and reviewing a change request

steps.title: Open Files
steps.body: Change Requests is a view within Vault, under Files.

steps.title: Open Change Requests
steps.body: Stored versions and release proposals have separate views.

steps.title: Start a request
steps.body: Choose New change request. Complete the Vault check-in walkthrough first so your training project has a version to propose.

steps.title: Name the proposed release
steps.body: Enter a Title and Reason, select at least one item and one version. A linked task is optional. The form warns when an item is used in an assembly.

steps.title: Find your request
steps.body: The list shows the submitted request. Open it for release notes, an optional AI impact summary, and review status.

steps.title: Open a request
steps.body: Open the first request card. If you already practiced here, it may not be the request you just submitted.

steps.title: Check release review
steps.body: This panel shows required sign-offs and, when linked, the GitHub PR title, head commit, reviews, checks, and timeline. Pending, failing, or stale gates block admin approval. Required reviewers may sign off here; only admins release a revision.

steps.title: Check build readiness
steps.body: On an open request, this lists where the items are used, open tasks they touch, missing required drawings, and assemblies on stale revisions. Blockers stop approval; warnings are the reviewer's call. Approved requests show their release package here instead.

steps.title: Review permissions
steps.body: Only ClubPM admins see Reject on an open request. A regular learner should skip this step; an officer can demonstrate it.

steps.title: Reject with a reason
steps.body: An admin can choose Reject and enter a review reason in the prompt. A regular learner should skip this step.

steps.title: Read the decision
steps.body: If an admin made a decision, the request detail stays open and shows its new status. A Review note appears when the reviewer entered one. If you skipped review, the request remains Open.
